About The Role And Team

Working at Uber means solving hard problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. As a CRM Marketing Associate, you will join the Global CRM team to bridge digital and real worlds, powering movement by showing millions of consumers the tangible impact of our products. You will lead the strategy and execution of acquisition campaigns across owned digital channels at a global scale.

This role is not about polished marketing; it’s about navigating the messiness of global expansion and program scaling. You will need a "go-get-it" attitude and a mindset built for ownership and adaptability as you move fast to respond to the needs of our growing membership base. If you are energized by the challenge of driving experimentation and reporting results under high-pressure conditions, this is where you’ll grow.

What You’ll Do


Develop and execute global end-to-end CRM strategies focused on acquisition overall expansion in a high-stakes environment. 
Navigate the complexity of marketing automation tools to build transactional, promotional, and informational content that converts users. 
Scale campaigns across new countries, balancing the need for speed with the messiness of local market requirements. 
Unblock growth by developing learning agendas, moving from experimentation planning to global scaling. 
Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and regional ops teams to identify consumer insights and influence strategy without direct authority. 
Own campaign performance end-to-end, reporting on KPIs and adjusting your approach based on shifting priorities and business needs.

4+ years of experience in customer marketing, customer communications, or the customer engagement space. 
Experience with marketing automation tools and multi-channel campaign management (email, push, in-app). 
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. 


Preferred Qualifications


Proven track record of delivering business results through A/B testing and experimentation at scale. 
Strong systems thinking approach with a fervent interest in how tech stacks empower CRM solutions. 
Ability to thrive in ambiguity and manage multiple stakeholders to remove structural roadblocks. 
Excellent project management skills with a rigorous attention to detail and swift execution. 


Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Description

Amazon Now is building the fastest shopping experience in Mexico, delivering groceries and essentials from dark stores in under 60 minutes.

We are looking for a Marketing Manager to own experimentation and campaign automation across the Amazon Now MX customer lifecycle. Reporting to the Growth Manager, this person will design, execute, and measure tests across in-app surfaces and external channels, and build automated workflows that scale lifecycle programs efficiently. They will work closely with the Product Manager on the team to translate experiment learnings into product and CX feature requests, ensuring a direct feedback loop between what we test and what we build.

For someone to be successful in this role, they need to embody the following:

Experimentation Executor: They design and run A/B tests and multivariate experiments with rigor — from hypothesis through execution and measurement. They work within defined strategies, use existing tools and processes, and clearly document results so the team can act on insights quickly.

Automation Builder: They build and maintain automated campaign workflows across CRM, push, in-app, and paid channels. They look for opportunities to reduce manual execution, increase personalization, and scale programs without scaling operational effort.

Data-Curious & Detail-Oriented: They are analytically minded with a bias for diving into performance data. They monitor, review, and report on experiment and campaign metrics, and make improvement recommendations based on what they find.

Collaborative Partner: They work cross-functionally with Product, BI, and Marketing to deliver outcomes. They coordinate planning with partner teams, articulate initiative details clearly, and escalate blockers when needed.

Key job responsibilities

Design, execute, and measure A/B tests and multivariate experiments across in-app surfaces and external channels.

Build and maintain automated campaign workflows that reduce manual execution and increase cohort-level personalization across the customer lifecycle

Partner closely with the Product Manager to translate experiment results and merchandising insights into product and CX feature requests that inform the storefront roadmap

Own in-app merchandising execution — including storefront placements, category curation, occasion-based discovery, and promotional real estate — ensuring the customer experience reflects the team's growth and lifecycle strategies

Monitor, audit, and report on campaign, experiment, and merchandising performance metrics, identifying trends and making improvement recommendations

Coordinate with partner teams on planning and execution of lifecycle marketing and merchandising initiatives

Apply marketing best practices and use existing tools and processes to ensure timely and high-quality delivery of initiatives

Identify opportunities to improve team processes, campaign workflows, and experimentation frameworks

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 2+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
 Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
 Bachelor's degree
 Experience delivering cross functional projects
 Experience with A/B or multivariate testing


Preferred Qualifications


 Knowledge of HTML, XML, and Excel
 Experience in e-commerce, retail or advertising, or experience in sales/business development
 Experience working with marketing tools including email, web analytics, CRM, and marketing automation platforms
 Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results

description:
Paystand is the world's leading blockchain-enabled B2B payments network, transforming commercial finance into a software-driven, zero-fee, and open ecosystem. Recognized as a CNBC/Statista 2026 World's Top Fintech company, Paystand delivers over a decade of on-chain payments experience to middle and large enterprises.

Paystand's network services more than one million payors that have moved $20+ billion in volume. With its acquisitions of Yaydoo, Teampay and Bitwage, Paystand's full-stack platform includes agentic AI, its USDb stablecoin, and AR/AP solutions on one tightly integrated network. Its non-profit arm, Paystand.org, advances the mission to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain technology.

What We Do

We built the financial system we always thought should exist: zero fees, zero friction, just your money, faster. Blockchain automates receivables and payables, cuts time-to-cash, and turns every transaction into revenue instead of cost.

Why We Do It

The current system takes a cut from the people who build, create, and grow — and calls it the cost of doing business. We don't buy that. Every fee we eliminate compounds into growth. We're here to decentralize finance and hand the power back to the businesses driving the real economy — extended further through Paystand.org's work to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain.

How We Do It

We don't wait for permission or for the industry to catch up — we build the future of finance ourselves, on-chain, in the open. Small moves now, monumental results later.

Join Us

We're not looking for people who want a job in fintech. We're looking for people who want to build what comes after it. Paystand is where you help lead a financial revolution instead of just reading about one. We stand on change. Come stand with us.

About The Role

Paystand is looking for an ABM & Digital Growth Manager to develop and run account-based and persona-based digital marketing programs across our business units.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Demand Generation, you will translate Acquisition & Growth strategy into programs that generate MQLs and SQLs within core ERP segments and help convert those leads into pipeline and revenue. Turn analysis into action. Track MQLs and SQLs in core ERP segments and their progression into pipeline and revenue. Identify gaps by business unit, program, and audience, and implement improvement. 
Manage programs through completion. Maintain campaign briefs, timelines, dependencies, and decision records. Communicate progress, surface blockers, and keep stakeholders aligned across AR, AP, Global Payroll/Payouts, and LATAM.


What success looks like


Growth in MQLs and SQLs within defined core ERP segments.

Timely program launches and consistent follow-through on improvements informed by testing. 


Performance will be evaluated using agreed qualification, cohort, and attribution definitions, with results reviewed by business unit, program, and audience.

title: Digital Product Optimization - (Experimentation strategy Lead)
description:
Job Title: Digital Product Optimization - Experimentation strategy lead

Work Location: Remote -Mexico

Working hours - 9 AM to 5 PM EST

Interview: Video 3 rounds




Digital Product Optimization - Experimentation strategy lead

About the team

Digital Product Optimization is a shared services and Center of Excellence team that enables A/B testing and experimentation horizontally across a large, consumer facing digital organization. We provide education, consultation, strategy, and delivery services for experiments, working with product teams across a portfolio of high traffic websites and mobile applications.

Our mission is to make experimentation a core component of how products get built. We work on live, in market experiences, helping teams gather evidence before they commit to building a feature and helping them optimize what they have just launched.




About the role

The Experimentation Strategy Lead is the subject matter expert who sits at the intersection of product management, design, engineering, and analytics. You will partner with a portfolio of roughly 10 to 12 product teams, taking their ideas and helping them become viable, trustworthy experiments.

This is a highly collaborative, partner facing role. Approximately 75 percent of your time is spent working directly with the teams we support. You own the discovery and planning phases of the experimentation lifecycle, from first conversation through to a fully specified, aligned test that is ready to be handed to our delivery function for execution.




What you will do

• Engage and educate product teams that are new to experimentation, and build their confidence in the practice.

• Consult with engaged teams to develop experimentation roadmaps that support and strengthen their product roadmaps.

• Evaluate incoming test requests for technical, statistical, and strategic feasibility, working with analytics and engineering partners to confirm what is possible.

• Facilitate strategic refinement of experiments, including sharpening hypotheses, validating the measurement approach, and confirming design assets are aligned and delivered.

• Build consensus across cross functional partners, and constructively challenge proposals when a stronger test design exists.

• Guide roughly a dozen concurrent experiments through the front end of our delivery process and hand them off cleanly for execution.

• Run recurring cross functional working sessions alongside your product partner meetings to keep work moving.

• Contribute to the team’s education and enablement materials, including playbooks, curriculum, and workshops.

• Translate complex analytical concepts into clear, actionable guidance for product managers who are not analytics specialists.




What we are looking for

Required

• Three to five years or more of focused experimentation experience, either as a dedicated specialist or in a product role where A/B testing was practiced rigorously, supported by a broader professional background.

• Strong data acumen, including a solid working grasp of experimental design, sample sizing, statistical significance, and test validity, and the ability to explain them clearly to non specialists.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with genuine attention to detail and a conscientious approach to keeping partners informed.

• Demonstrated ability to build consensus, influence without authority, and bridge gaps between teams with differing views.

• Experience in consumer facing (B2C) digital products with meaningful traffic volume.

• Comfort operating in a shared service or internal consulting model, managing a portfolio of stakeholders at once.

• Availability to work consistently within US Eastern or US Pacific business hours.




Preferred

• Experience in a large, complex enterprise environment.

• Exposure to both web and mobile app experimentation.

• Working familiarity with digital analytics and experience intelligence platforms such as Adobe Analytics and Contentsquare.

• Contextual familiarity with an enterprise experimentation platform such as Adobe Target or Optimizely.

• Background in conversion rate optimization, growth, or marketing product management.

• Some instructional design or enablement experience.

• Experience in travel, hospitality, entertainment, or destination commerce.

• Prior Disney experience with Product Management/ Experimentation teams




Good to know

• This is a strategy and consulting role rather than a hands on build role. You will not be configuring experiments in the testing platform.

• You will partner closely with analytics specialists who own the formal analysis. You need to be fluent enough to ask sharp questions and interpret results, not to run the analysis yourself.

• A dedicated delivery owner takes each experiment through build and launch once your planning work is complete.

description:
About Us

Inflection Club is a private co-investment community for accredited investors, operators, and family offices who want direct access to pre-IPO deals in the companies shaping the future. Built under Catalyst Capital Holdings, we provide curated access from early to late-stage opportunities that traditionally only flow to endowments, pension funds, and institutional allocators - names like Anthropic, Polymarket, Kraken, and Lovable.

We help our members invest in those companies 12 to 18 months before they go public, deal-by-deal, with full discretion.

description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution.

When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

Job Description

Are you a growth-obsessed SEO leader who knows how to win in the era of AI-driven search? Nielsen is seeking a Senior Manager, SEO to lead the organic growth engine for Nielsen.com. Reporting to the Director of Website Strategy, you will bridge technical SEO and creative storytelling, architecting search ecosystems that satisfy both traditional algorithms and generative AI models (AIO/LLMs) while driving measurable pipeline growth.

Key Responsibilities


Strategic SEO & Content Planning: Own the SEO roadmap for Nielsen.com; partner with Creative and Content teams to produce high-impact content optimized for human intent and LLM discovery.
Technical SEO & Architecture: Lead technical SEO across CMS platforms (WordPress VIP, Webflow). Define requirements for site architecture, schema markup, and performance alongside Web Ops and Engineering teams.
Tooling & Platform Administration: Act as the primary admin and power-user for enterprise tools (BrightEdge, Screaming Frog, SEMrush).
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Paid Media on holistic SEM strategies, align with Social/Email channels, and provide SEO guidance to global international teams.
Content Audits & Enablement: Conduct regular content audits, gap analyses, and train internal content contributors on tagging, keyword strategies, and AIO best practices.


Who You Are


The SEO Architect: You build content ecosystems designed for the Generative AI era.
The Growth Strategist: You view SEO as a product—relentlessly testing, iterating, and optimizing for conversion.
The Technical Partner: You speak the language of developers and translate complex technical requirements into actionable web tasks.
Data-Driven Storyteller: You turn search data into compelling digital experiences.


Qualifications


Experience: 4 - 7 years of experience in SEO, content strategy, and digital marketing within SaaS, data, or tech industries; matrixed/agency experience required.
Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress VIP, Webflow, BrightEdge, SEMrush, and Screaming Frog.
AI & Search Fluency: Proven experience applying AI tools to SEO workflows (prompt engineering, AIO strategy, automated insights) alongside traditional technical SEO (schema, indexing, site structure).
Analytical & Cross-Functional Leadership: Exceptional analytical skills with a test-and-learn mindset and strong stakeholder management abilities.


Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Love Latin American stories and want to make them hits? Prime Video is looking for a Brand Manager to lead marketing campaigns for our Local Originals in Mexico and CLARCO (Colombia, Argentina, Chile), from first positioning to launch day.

Prime Video is a premium streaming service available in 240+ countries and territories. It offers Originals, exclusive content, live sports, add-on channels and the Prime Video Store. Own end-to-end marketing strategy for a slate of Local Originals in Mexico and CLARCO, from greenlight through launch and post-launch.

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Grow account revenue: find the next highest-impact use case inside each customer and turn it into new scope.

Build rapport in person: travel with our GTM team around 50% of the time, shadow and then lead customer sessions, and know the product better than anyone else in the room.

For everything else, engage our Growth Science, Product, and Data teams efficiently by providing clear customer context, business impact, relevant evidence, and what you have already investigated. Respect their time by minimizing unnecessary meetings and prioritizing clear, asynchronous communication. Own the follow-up, keep the customer informed, and ensure key learnings feed into the product roadmap.

Expand across departments and use cases: map which other teams (paid media, CRM, merchandising, pricing, finance) can run their decisions on Hilbert, find the next highest-impact use case in each, and turn it into new scope.

Embed Hilbert into activation surfaces: connect Hilbert’s outputs to the tools where the customer’s teams already act, from ad platforms and CRM/CDP to promo, merchandising and planning systems, so every insight flows straight into execution and becomes part of the daily workflow.
Join GTM funnel reviews: take part in the regular funnel reviews with the GTM team, and know which leads are coming to you next.
Grow the shared library: add answers, case studies and customer examples, so expert guidance becomes something the whole team reuses.

Around 5 to 8 years of experience: an engineering or natural sciences background, followed by an analytical role in management consulting or a similar setting; pure customer success leaders with a strong analytical edge are also welcome.

Strongly analytical: you write SQL and understand customer data sources, key business definitions, data coverage and freshness, and the meaning and limitations of model outputs well enough to explain them and investigate routine questions. You can build a business case and present it to a CFO or CMO.
Driven by real business transformation: insight isn't enough until it changes how the customer's business runs.
Continuous learning: you don't know insurance or grocery yet, and you'll figure it out fast. You're a problem solver who hacks most of the job yourself and knows exactly who to bring in for the rest.

Excellent with customers: polished and high-energy, at ease in every customer conversation from small talk to the boardroom, credible with senior stakeholders, and able to build relationships that outlast a single project.
Strong stakeholder management is a must: you navigate complex organizations and keep senior and day-to-day stakeholders aligned.
Happy to travel often across your region, around 50% of the time and sometimes to a different customer city every week, and to work with an owner's mindset in a fast-moving startup.
Fluent in English and Spanish.
Nice to have: deep vertical expertise in retail, grocery, or financial services, or existing relationships with enterprise B2C companies. Portuguese is a plus.
Recruiter screen, 30 minutes.

GTM interview with the GTM leadership in Latin America, 30 minutes: a customer relationship you owned, from first meeting to live usage or expansion, and how you managed the stakeholders along the way.
Hiring manager interview, 30 minutes: how you work with customers and with our Growth, Product and GTM teams.
Growth case with our Growth team, 60 minutes: a real customer case, from the business problem and the data it needs to the use case, the success criteria and the business case for expansion.
Team and final interviews: meet the people you’ll work with day to day, and our leadership.
References: two from clients, one from a colleague you worked with on customer accounts.
Work from anywhere. Two weeks a year to take your laptop somewhere new, whether that’s a beach in Mallorca or your family’s kitchen table.
Sharpen your English. Business English classes, for when the boardroom pitch needs to land perfectly.
And many more. We’re always cooking up new ways to support our team. Come build the future with us, and grow alongside a company that’s investing in yours.

For everything else, engage our Growth Science, Product, and Data teams efficiently by providing clear customer context, business impact, relevant evidence, and what you have already investigated. Respect their time by minimizing unnecessary meetings and prioritizing clear, asynchronous communication. Own the follow-up, keep the customer informed, and ensure key learnings feed into the product roadmap.
Expand across departments and use cases: map which other teams (paid media, CRM, merchandising, pricing, finance) can run their decisions on Hilbert, find the next highest-impact use case in each, and turn it into new scope.
Embed Hilbert into activation surfaces: connect Hilbert’s outputs to the tools where the customer’s teams already act, from ad platforms and CRM/CDP to promo, merchandising and planning systems, so every insight flows straight into execution and becomes part of the daily workflow.
Join GTM funnel reviews: take part in the regular funnel reviews with the GTM team, and know which leads are coming to you next.
Grow the shared library: add answers, case studies and customer examples, so expert guidance becomes something the whole team reuses.


What you bring


Around 5 to 8 years of experience: an engineering or natural sciences background, followed by an analytical role in management consulting or a similar setting; pure customer success leaders with a strong analytical edge are also welcome.
Strongly analytical: you write SQL and understand customer data sources, key business definitions, data coverage and freshness, and the meaning and limitations of model outputs well enough to explain them and investigate routine questions. You can build a business case and present it to a CFO or CMO.
Driven by real business transformation: insight isn't enough until it changes how the customer's business runs.
Continuous learning: you don't know insurance or grocery yet, and you'll figure it out fast. You're a problem solver who hacks most of the job yourself and knows exactly who to bring in for the rest.
Excellent with customers: polished and high-energy, at ease in every customer conversation from small talk to the boardroom, credible with senior stakeholders, and able to build relationships that outlast a single project.
Strong stakeholder management is a must: you navigate complex organizations and keep senior and day-to-day stakeholders aligned.
Happy to travel often across your region, around 50% of the time and sometimes to a different customer city every week, and to work with an owner's mindset in a fast-moving startup.
Fluent in English and Spanish.
Nice to have: deep vertical expertise in retail, grocery, or financial services, or existing relationships with enterprise B2C companies. Portuguese is a plus.


Reporting and location

You report to the Head of Forward Deployed Growth and work closely with our GTM leadership in Latin America, as the growth counterpart to the region’s GTM team. You’re on the move with GTM, joining new leads and customer meetings from the first conversation. Our Growth Science and Product teams own the product’s logic, models and playbooks, train you on them and support you on the deepest problems, and our delivery engineering team builds and runs each deployment with you. You are based in Latin America, ideally Mexico City or Lima. The role may start remotely while we build Hilbert’s regional presence, with travel to customers across the region of around 50 percent, and relocation within Latin America may be needed as our hub takes shape.

Compensation

Base salary, plus variable pay tied to performance and the revenue you help drive (proof-of-concept conversion, renewals and expansion), plus equity. Details are shared in next steps.

Interview process


Recruiter screen, 30 minutes.
GTM interview with the GTM leadership in Latin America, 30 minutes: a customer relationship you owned, from first meeting to live usage or expansion, and how you managed the stakeholders along the way.
Hiring manager interview, 30 minutes: how you work with customers and with our Growth, Product and GTM teams.
Growth case with our Growth team, 60 minutes: a real customer case, from the business problem and the data it needs to the use case, the success criteria and the business case for expansion.
Team and final interviews: meet the people you’ll work with day to day, and our leadership.
References: two from clients, one from a colleague you worked with on customer accounts.


Why join us

At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go.

On top of that, here’s how we take care of our team:


Work from anywhere. Two weeks a year to take your laptop somewhere new, whether that’s a beach in Mallorca or your family’s kitchen table.
Sharpen your English. Business English classes, for when the boardroom pitch needs to land perfectly.
And many more. We’re always cooking up new ways to support our team. Come build the future with us, and grow alongside a company that’s investing in yours.

description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About The Role

As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer

experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug

problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll

diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both

engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI

workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics

workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to

grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over

time.

Tech Profile


Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.
Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.
Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.
Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to experiment and iterate.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root cause of issues.


Must Have


Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under tight deadlines.
Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and propose solutions.
Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward action.
Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.


Why join us?


Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe is investing in building out its Global Professional Services team to actively engage all customers from Fortune 100s to startups to help accelerate their adoption of Stripe capabilities. The team is responsible for ensuring that our customers deploy quickly with high quality integrations. It then partners closely with front line developers and technical leaders to ensure our customers continue to derive strategic value from Stripe and grow with us as our respective product portfolio expands. In addition, as we master the craft of deployment services, help build the asset and strategy that will enable us to scale through our partner ecosystem.

The Stripe Accelerate is a 3-month offering that unlocks access to a team of Stripe experts to help the user through every step of the implementation. This is included as part of Stripe solution, at no extra cost to our users. Accelerate Onboarding Managers provide prescriptive guidance and planning for the user’s onboarding journey. Onboarding Specialists provide product workshops, best practices, regular check-ins, and technical Q&A. This offering is targeted at Startup and SMB users.

A Few Key Features Of Accelerate Include


Specialized experts: Accelerate experts provide experience helping customers integrate Stripe technology in thousands of projects.
Project management consists of a kick off call, regular check-ins, email Q&A to help unblock your team.
Product workshops and training for fraud and dashboard



What you’ll do

The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for providing technical guidance to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe. They proactively address technical queries, troubleshoot issues, and provide solutions to ensure a seamless onboarding process. They work closely with users to understand their needs, offer guidance on best practices, and anticipate and address any potential technical challenges. The Onboarding Specialist collaborates with cross-functional teams, escalates issues as needed, and maintains accurate records of user interactions. Their goal is to provide exceptional customer service and ensure that users have a positive and successful onboarding experience with Stripe.

Contributing to the improvement of onboarding processes and documentation.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Advanced English proficiency- fluent in written and spoken.

Strong technical understanding of APIs and experience with SaaS solutions.

Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with financial systems, online payments, or e-commerce platforms.

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

description:
About Osmind

Osmind is a public benefit corporation advancing psychiatry through technology, services, and real-world evidence. Our software and services are used by 1,000+ interventional psychiatry practices across the U.S., the largest network of its kind. Our platform also supports life sciences companies developing and scaling access to cutting-edge treatments.

The Opportunity

RevOps at Osmind owns the revenue architecture across the full customer journey, from first marketing touch through closed-won, onboarding, expansion, and retention. That journey runs across four distinct go-to-market motions: scaled SMB sales, mid market sales-led with outbound, clinician customer engagement and upsell, and enterprise life sciences. Each has its own pipeline definitions, handoff logic, channels and conversion metrics. Keeping them connected and compounding is the core challenge. This role reports to the Revenue Operations Lead and works across all four.

You will work in a modern stack (HubSpot, Gong, Cargo, Unify, Metabase, Stripe, DocuSign, Arrows, Pylon, Chameleon) and be expected to extend it with AI-native workflows from day one. You will have the AI tools you need, whether that is Claude, Cursor, Cargo, Zapier or Lovable. A strong candidate would be able to sit in a working session, follow what the business is trying to do, and turn it into system work that holds up.

The role is built to grow. You will sit in the architecture, pricing and segmentation discussions rather than receive the output of them, and take on more of the design work as your understanding of the business deepens. The team is small, so you will have direct access to the people making those decisions.

What success looks like in the first 6 months: you own the systems work, and the teams that depend on it come to you directly. You have shipped at least one automation that took real manual work off someone's plate. You understand how the revenue engine fits together well enough to be forming a view on where it should go next.

What You'll Own

GTM systems

Build and maintain the CRM and the tooling around it: workflows, properties, pipelines, lists, dashboards, integrations, permissions. HubSpot is the center of gravity. You own the recurring hygiene that keeps the data trustworthy, and you close out the requests that come in from every function.

Revenue data and reporting

Keep the deal, product and revenue data accurate as the business changes shape. Build and maintain the dashboards leadership, sales and finance run on, and turn around ad hoc pulls fast. Support the reconciliation between what a customer is contracted for and what has actually been collected.

Deal process

Run the operational side of the deal desk: intake, routing, approvals, rate tables and contract templates. Sales gets a pricing decision back quickly and consistently, and you are part of why.

Campaign and outbound operations

Build and QA the target lists behind outbound and upsell campaigns. Keep account and contact data enriched and deduplicated, load audiences, and maintain the routing and attribution behind sourced pipeline.

Process design and automation

Get the process right before automating it. The first question is what the correct, durable process is and whether it still holds when volume triples. The second is how AI and automation make that process faster, cheaper and more accurate. Both matter, in that order. Start with the work you touch every week (enrichment, routing, hygiene, reporting) and build so the end user of that workflow or process has something that holds up rather than something that has to be rebuilt.

Documentation and enablement

Write down how each system actually works as you build in it, and answer the questions other teams bring. This is what keeps systems knowledge from sitting with one person.

Your First 90 Days


30 days: working knowledge of the GTM stack as it is configured here and the deal process end to end. Owning the inbound systems request queue.
60 days: running the recurring hygiene and reporting cadence independently. First automation shipped against something manual and weekly. Documentation started for the systems you have touched.
90 days: trusted across sales, finance and customer success to have their systems work handled. Bringing back what is breaking and where the next fix should go, unprompted.

Process first, then AI. You define the durable, scalable process before automating it, then use AI to make it faster and more accurate. You have shipped something real this way and have a point of view on where the tooling falls short.
Precision with data. You check your own work, trace a number back to its source, and know the difference between a number that is right and a number that looks right.

Professional Development: Stay up to date with certifications, industry trends, platform updates, and new capabilities to strengthen technical expertise and contribute innovation.
New Business Support: Contribute tactical analysis, benchmarks, audits, and basic campaign configurations to proposals and pitches led by the Head of Paid Media.
Self-management & time management: Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and remain focused in a fast-paced environment.
Critical thinking: Ability to challenge assumptions, identify root causes, and propose improvements.
Analytical mindset: Ability to interpret data and dashboards and translate findings into actionable insights.
Quality orientation: Commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work from the start.
Proactive collaboration: Ability to recognize when support is needed and collaborate effectively with others.
Continuous learning: Willingness to stay current with tools, processes, technologies, and methodologies.
Adaptability: Ability to adapt quickly to new tools, teams, priorities, and processes.
Documentation & operational discipline: Ability to maintain clear records of processes, learnings, deliverables, and work within company guidelines.
Effective communication: Ability to communicate progress, challenges, and results clearly, both verbally and in writing.
Ownership mindset: Takes responsibility for the overall outcome, not only their individual tasks.

description:
Who are we?

Incubeta is an AI-powered, end-to-end marketing agency helping ambitious brands use marketing as a driver of sustainable growth and long-term business success.

Operating across 18 countries, we connect media, creative, data and technology through our proprietary Seamless approach, helping brands navigate an increasingly complex marketing landscape and deliver measurable business impact.

At Incubeta, we value an entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement. We believe our people are at the heart of our success and encourage everyone to challenge conventional thinking and bring new ideas to the table.

About The Role

The Paid Media Specialist is responsible for executing, optimizing, and analyzing paid media campaigns with a high level of technical rigor, ensuring measurable results aligned with client and business objectives.

The Specialist will bring the Paid Media strategy to life by ensuring high-quality campaign execution, efficient budget management, accurate platform implementation, and continuous generation of actionable insights to improve performance.

Key Responsibilities


Campaign Execution: Set up, launch, and monitor multi-channel paid media campaigns, ensuring accurate technical implementation and alignment with the defined strategy.
Media Plans & Operational Monitoring: Develop and maintain detailed media plans, monitor campaign data, manage alerts and automation, identify performance or spend deviations, and ensure all tactical elements are accurately executed within the relevant platforms.
Continuous Optimization: Perform regular, data-driven optimizations to improve campaign performance and maximize KPIs such as ROAS, CPL, and CPA.
Budget Management: Monitor daily pacing to ensure spend remains within budget and adjust investment levels according to campaign needs.
Technical Quality & Compliance: Ensure campaigns follow technical standards, platform best practices, tracking requirements, and QA processes.
Reporting & Analysis: Create clear reports and actionable insights that explain performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
Documentation & Processes: Maintain accurate processes, records, documentation, and operational learnings to ensure traceability and efficiency across the team.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with CSMs, Data, Creative, Client teams, and the Head of Paid Media to execute integrated campaigns and resolve technical or operational needs.
Professional Development: Stay up to date with certifications, industry trends, platform updates, and new capabilities to strengthen technical expertise and contribute innovation.
New Business Support: Contribute tactical analysis, benchmarks, audits, and basic campaign configurations to proposals and pitches led by the Head of Paid Media.


Skills & Competencies


Self-management & time management: Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and remain focused in a fast-paced environment.
Critical thinking: Ability to challenge assumptions, identify root causes, and propose improvements.
Analytical mindset: Ability to interpret data and dashboards and translate findings into actionable insights.
Quality orientation: Commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work from the start.
Proactive collaboration: Ability to recognize when support is needed and collaborate effectively with others.
Continuous learning: Willingness to stay current with tools, processes, technologies, and methodologies.
Adaptability: Ability to adapt quickly to new tools, teams, priorities, and processes.
Documentation & operational discipline: Ability to maintain clear records of processes, learnings, deliverables, and work within company guidelines.
Effective communication: Ability to communicate progress, challenges, and results clearly, both verbally and in writing.
Ownership mindset: Takes responsibility for the overall outcome, not only their individual tasks.


Education


Bachelor's degree in Advertising, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
Master's degree in Digital Marketing, Analytics, or Business Management is a plus.


Experience


2+ years of experience in branding and/or performance marketing and digital media buying, with experience across platforms such as:
Google Ads
Microsoft/Bing Ads
DV360
Campaign Manager 360
Search Ads 360
Meta (Facebook & Instagram)
LinkedIn
Experience with reporting tools such as Looker Studio.
Experience with digital measurement tools, including Google Analytics 4 (GA4), pixel implementation, and tagging.
Strong ability to develop branding and/or performance media strategies.
Intermediate to advanced English, with the ability to read technical documentation and communicate with global clients.
Experience in consulting, agency, or client-services environments is a plus.

Preferred Certifications


Google Ads Certifications (Search, Display, Video, Shopping)
Meta Blueprint
Google Analytics 4 Certification
Google Marketing Platform Certifications (DV360, CM360, SA360)


What We're Looking For

We are looking for a data-driven and technically strong Paid Media Specialist who is comfortable working across multiple platforms, takes ownership of campaign performance, and combines strong execution with analytical thinking.

If you are passionate about digital media, enjoy solving performance challenges, and want to work in a global, collaborative environment, we would love to hear from you.

Why Incubeta?

You will join a global, collaborative and entrepreneurial environment where you can have a direct impact on how media is delivered across the Americas.

This is an opportunity to shape the standards, processes and operating model behind a growing media execution function, while working alongside senior media leadership and a global media capability team.

Owner Mindset

Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace new tools and AI.

description:
The Corporate Web Publisher is responsible for updates, modification, creation, and publication of web pages on our corporate website (NXP.com), with prior analysis of compliance to corporate guidelines. The role also encompasses SEO/AEO best practices and the use of AI-powered tools to optimize content discoverability and publishing efficiency.

The publisher utilizes corporate and external tools to follow the proper processes during the full publishing cycle, from receiving requests in the ticketing system to executing them in the content management system.

The ideal candidate is someone who not only masters today's tools, but actively brings new knowledge and emerging practices to the team, helping elevate the group's capabilities and ways of working as the web publishing landscape continues to evolve rapidly.

SOMOS ALSEA

Con un propósito que nos une —entregar felicidad y experiencias llenas de sabor— y con valores genuinos que dan vida a nuestro nombre: Actitud Ganadora, Liderazgo Involucrado, Servicio Sorprendente, Espíritu Colaborativo y Atención al Detalle, nos proyectamos como el lugar ideal para crecer y desarrollarse en el sector restaurantero, construyendo una cultura auténtica que deja huella en nuestros colaboradores, clientes y comunidades.

En Alsea, todas las personas son bienvenidas. La inclusión se vive en nuestra gente y la diversidad se expresa en el sabor de cada una de nuestras marcas.




Nuestra estrategia de negocio pone a la cultura, el talento y la innovación en el centro, guiando cada decisión y fortaleciendo cada paso que damos como organización. Porque cuando trabajamos con felicidad, todo sabe mejor.

¡te invitamos a participar en esta vacante!




Sr Brand Manager – Raising Cane´s

Objetivo del puesto:

Asegurar el desarrollo de las categorías Nestlé a su cargo, en el canal Clubes de Precios, a través del diseño de estrategias que permitan crecer la presencia y rotación de nuestros productos con el cliente. Identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y alinear los planes de categoría con la estrategia general del cliente.

Un día en la vida de…


Conocer y entender la estrategia de crecimiento de la cuenta, para crear sinergias con los planes de desarrollo de categorías Nestlé. Buscar oportunidades de crecimiento en beneficio de nuestras marcas y de los objetivos del canal.
Diseñar y ejecutar planes comerciales para las categorías a su cargo, alineados a la estrategia de las Unidades de Negocio, que permitan alcanzar los objetivos anuales de venta (sell-in y sell-out).
Manejo y control del presupuesto TTS para las categorías a su cargo. Administración de forma eficiente para maximizar su impacto sobre la venta. 
Seguimiento a la evolución de venta mensual, y ejecución de planes de generación de demanda mensuales. 
Coordinar la ejecución en punto de venta de los planes por categoríaa, en conjunto con el equipo de Operaciones.
Conocimiento y manejo de herramientas de gestión de ventas. (TTS, Sistemas de información internas y externas.) 


Lo que te hará exitoso


Licenciatura o Ingeniería en áreas comerciales, industriales, sistemas o afines.
Experiencia de 1 a 2 años en el sector comercial. 
Capacidad para analizar KPIs comerciales (Sell In, Sell Out, inversiones y desarrollo de categorías) y convertirlos en planes de acción. 
Habilidad para negociar e influir con compradores y áreas comerciales, generando relaciones de largo plazo con los clientes. 
Experiencia diseñando y ejecutando estrategias comerciales orientadas al crecimiento de volumen, participación y rentabilidad. 
Dominio de herramientas de gestión y análisis comercial, incluyendo Excel, SAP y Power BI, combinado con una fuerte orientación a resultados.

title: Líder de Investigación de Mercado
skills: Lidera la investigación de mercado y la generación de conocimiento sobre clientes, competidores y dinámicas del entorno, aplicando metodologías cualitativas y cuantitativas y coordinando las fuentes y proveedores requeridos, para identificar tendencias, necesidades, oportunidades y riesgos que contribuyan a las decisiones estratégicas y comerciales del negocio.

Gestiona las fuentes y auditorías de información de mercado, integrando, validando e interpretando datos provenientes de fuentes públicas y privadas para garantizar información confiable, consistente, trazable y oportuna que constituya una referencia para el negocio.

Asegura la generación y entrega de información recurrente de mercado, monitoreando los indicadores bajo responsabilidad de la función y consolidando información proveniente de las distintas fuentes disponibles, para proporcionar una visión confiable y oportuna del desempeño y evolución del mercado.

Genera proactivamente inteligencia, insights y recomendaciones de mercado, analizando e integrando información cuantitativa, cualitativa, interna y externa para identificar tendencias, oportunidades, riesgos y cambios relevantes que contribuyan a anticipar necesidades y fortalecer la toma de decisiones del negocio.

Impulsa la evolución de las capacidades de investigación e inteligencia de mercado, evaluando e incorporando nuevas metodologías, fuentes, herramientas analíticas, automatizaciones y tecnologías para incrementar la eficiencia, calidad, profundidad y oportunidad de los análisis y entregables de la función.

Asesora a las áreas de negocio en la interpretación y aplicación de información e inteligencia de mercado, traduciendo análisis complejos en conclusiones y recomendaciones claras para contribuir a la planeación, priorización y seguimiento de iniciativas estratégicas y comerciales.

Cumplir las políticas internas aplicables a la confidencialidad, privacidad, seguridad y resguardo de la información; utilizar únicamente fuentes y proveedores autorizados; y asegurar el manejo responsable de información sensible de mercado, comercial y de incentivos.

Contar con un mínimo de 3 años en una posición similar en empresas internacionales, con experiencia en investigación e inteligencia de mercado, análisis cuantitativo y cualitativo, auditorías y fuentes de mercado, generación de insights, visualización y comunicación de información, y gestión de proyectos y proveedores.

Excel avanzado, PowerPoint avanzado, Power BI, Tableau o plataformas equivalentes de visualización; Structured Query Language (SQL); análisis estadístico; metodologías cualitativas y cuantitativas; bases de datos y grandes volúmenes de información; auditorías, cubos y fuentes de mercado.
Formación académica.
Nivel de Inglés: B2.
Contar con especialidad o posgrado en investigación de mercados, analítica, inteligencia de negocios, estadística, ciencia de datos, mercadotecnia o área afín.

Experiencia en R o Python para análisis estadístico y automatización; herramientas de analítica avanzada; uso de inteligencia artificial generativa y agentes de IA para investigación, análisis, automatización y generación de insights, aplicando criterios de validación, privacidad y uso responsable; y conocimiento de fuentes especializadas como IQVIA, GOB360.
Experiencia en investigación de mercado con productos GLP1 y/o productos OTC.

Viva Talent connects US companies with Executive Assistants and Recruiting Coordinators and opens meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America and South Africa. Who you are

You’re a hands-on marketing leader who has already solved this challenge elsewhere.

5+ years managing & leading marketing teams end to end, from defining the strategy to driving execution and results.

This is a rare seat where you build the function instead of inheriting it. You'll own the number, the playbook, and the team, with a direct line to the founders and real autonomy over how Viva grows.

The work you’ll do will be pivotal to Viva’s growth, revenue, and team and will directly impact how we reach our mission of creating 1,000 meaningful career opportunities across Latin America.

description:
We don't think about job roles in a traditional way.

We are anti-silo.

Anti-career stagnation.

Anti-conventional.

Beyond ONE is a digital services provider radically reshaping the personalised digital ecosystems of consumers in high growth markets around the world.

We're building a digital services aggregator platform, with a strong telco foundation, and a profitable growth strategy that empowers users to drive their own experience—subscribe once, source from many, and only pay for what you actually use.

Since being founded in ****, we've acquired Virgin Mobile MEA, Friendi Mobile MEA and Virgin Mobile LATAM (with 6.5 million subscribers) and **** dedicated colleagues across Chile, Colombia, KSA, Kuwait, Mexico, Oman, Pakistan and UAE.

To disrupt for good takes a rebellious spirit, a questioning mind and a warm heart.

We really care about how to get things done and not who manages who.

We benefit from our diversity, and together, we disrupt the way we and others thinking about our lives for good.

Do you want to exchange ideas, learn from each other and leave your mark on our journey?

This is the place for you.

Role Purpose

Why this role matters: As a Digital Acquisition Sr.

Director, you will lead the digital growth engine for Virgin Mobile Mexico, driving customer acquisition and revenue through high-impact performance marketing strategies.

This role is critical in scaling the business efficiently, ensuring every investment delivers measurable growth while strengthening our position in a highly competitive market.

Strong and consistent subscriber growth across digital channels

Optimized CAC with clear improvements in ROI and marketing efficiency

High-performing digital funnels with improved conversion rates (web and app)

Data-driven decision-making embedded across all marketing initiatives

Seamless collaboration across local and global stakeholders

A high-performing, agile digital marketing team delivering measurable impact

This is an opportunity to own and shape the digital acquisition strategy for a fast-growing, digital-first brand.

If you thrive in performance-driven environments, enjoy combining data with creativity, and want to make a tangible impact on business growth, this role offers both autonomy and visibility at a leadership level.

Key Responsibilities

In This Role, You Will Be Responsible For

Performance Marketing

Own digital acquisition strategy across paid media (Meta, Google, Tik Tok, programmatic)

Drive subscriber growth, CAC optimization, and ROI improvements

Manage performance budgets with strong discipline on attribution and incrementality

E-commerce & Conversion Optimization

Optimize digital sales funnels (web/app) to improve conversion rates

Partner with product and UX teams to enhance user journeys

Lead A/B testing roadmap across landing pages, checkout, and onboarding

Data & Analytics

Own marketing dashboards and reporting (CAC, LTV, ROAS, funnel metrics)

Leverage tools like Google Analytics, Apps Flyer/Adjust, CRM platforms

Translate data into actionable insights for growth

Brand & Content Alignment

Ensure performance marketing aligns with brand positioning

Collaborate with creative teams to deliver high-performing ad creatives

Maintain consistency across digital touchpoints

Cross-functional Leadership

Work closely with product, commercial, and technology teams

Manage external agencies and partners

Mentor and build a high-performing digital marketing team

Education

bachelor's degree in marketing, Business, Economics, or a related field (Master's degree is a plus)

Experience

8–10 years of experience in digital marketing, with strong focus on performance marketing

Proven track record of scaling digital acquisition and driving revenue growth

Experience in telecom, MVNO, e-commerce, or digital-first businesses

Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

Technical Skills

Strong expertise in paid media platforms (Meta, Google, Tik Tok, programmatic)

Hands‐on experience with analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Apps Flyer, Adjust, CRM platforms)

Deep understanding of CAC, LTV, ROAS, and funnel optimization

Familiarity with mobile app growth and attribution frameworks

Unique Attributes

Highly analytical with a strong data‐driven mindset

Strategic thinker with a hands‐on, execution‐focused approach

Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

Ability to operate both at a strategic and tactical level

Fluency in both Spanish and English (mandatory)

The Senior Manager, BI Modeling & Dashboard Design transforms data into actionable insights by designing, building, and governing scalable business intelligence dashboards that establish durable internal analytics capability.
